name: e2e-rail
description: Change-aware Playwright E2E: run only the specs a change can reach, record every run against a code fingerprint so a stale green is never reused, and shard by measured durations.

plugins.name: e2e-rail
plugins.description: Change-aware Playwright E2E — an autopilot skill and hooks, a read-only impact analyst and the e2e-rail CLI on PATH (personal mode), or the CLI pinned in the repo (pnpm add -D github:sh5623/e2e-rail#v0.4.2).
